Thanks for the runbook link during the call earlier. We're ready to move our offer to activation but have a couple of questions about the signer workflow and the exact evidence you need from our side for the identity/tenant proofs. Quick points:

Hi John —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front:

- The DocuSign signer being the procurement lead is fine; legal needs to see the executed MSA and a matching billing/contracting contact. We will reconcile names during the tenant proofing step.
- Please upload the following to the publisher portal:
  * manifest.json (finalized)
  * sku-mapping.csv
  * identity-claim.pdf (tenant admin proof)

  Send the executed MSA to our legal mailbox (legal@redwood.ai) and paste the DocuSign envelope link here — we'll pull it for records.
- Service principal: engineering prefers a pre-provisioned service principal with contributor on the publisher subscription so we can validate webhooks/servicehooks during the staging test. If you cannot pre-provision, we can do a deferred check but it will add ~48 hours to validation.

ETA: once we receive the MSA and the identity claim and the SP is provisioned, typical activation is 2 business days for the technical gate (assuming no manifest errors). Co-sell tagging and marketplace certification can take an additional 2–5 days depending on partner intake windows.

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik to coordinate the SP validation and the legal ingest. Please attach the MSA when you reply and include the publisher tenant ID and the principal/client-id for the SP.

Next steps checklist (what we need from Acme):
- Attach executed MSA (PDF or DocuSign URL)
- Upload manifest.json + sku-mapping.csv to portal
- Provide publisher tenant ID and SP client-id/tenant-id
- Confirm billing/contact name that should appear on contract

Thanks — I'll queue this for a quick engineering smoke once we have the SP info.

— Stephanie
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Subject: Internal: ACME publisher activation workitems (pre-provision SP + legal ingest)
Attachments: (internal checklist embedded)

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in on ACME (deal ACME-OPP-7834). External has signed MSA pending upload; they asked for a firm ETA. I outlined the target timeline below. Please confirm owners and any blockers.

Goal: Activate offer and complete technical gate by end of day 2025-08-20 (client launch 2025-08-25).

Technical tasks (owner):
- Pre-provision service principal on ACME publisher subscription and share client-id/tenant-id (Karthik) — request: contributor role so staging servicehooks validate. Target: 8/14 EOD.
- Run manifest lint and sku mapping verification against our staging pipeline (Engineering) — Karthik to triage any manifest errors. Target: 8/15 midday.
- Confirm webhooks/servicehook endpoints respond from ACME staging (Karthik) — target: 8/15.

Commercial/legal tasks (owner):
- Advise legal to expect the DocuSign envelope and ingest into our records (Marissa) — confirm mailbox ingestion and whether any redlines exist. Target: 8/14 morning.
- Ensure co-sell tags/partner metadata are set in HubSpot record (Marissa) — update record with publisher tenant ID once provided.

Risks/notes:
- If ACME cannot pre-provision SP, add 48 hours to technical gate.
- Manifest schema errors typically cause the largest delays; please allocate an hour on 8/15 for rapid fixes.

Can you ACK and say if you need rights to the Acme subscription (we have contact info).

Thanks,
— Steph
